'''Saludor Narubo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Narubo was a neurobiologist and developed vaccines for some of the most deadly diseases in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was based in a laboratory in the [[Middle City]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. However, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] suspected that Narubo was developing dangerous biological agents for the Empire, so they sent a team of agents to Taris, to capture him. The agents gained custody of Narubo and began to transport him to [[Taris Spaceport]], where a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] was waiting, to take Narubo off-world. However, they were tailed by [[Karvas Toll]], an Imperial agent who planned to free Narubo from the Alliance.
